stories.title: New Mexico wanted free childcare for all. This is what's worked — and what hasn't
stories.summary: A year ago in November, New Mexico became the first state to offer free childcare to every eligible family, regardless of income.

stories.title: Midterm voters ended the long-running GOP dominance in state legislatures
stories.summary: In several states, Democrats took control of legislatures that had been divided and they weakened GOP dominance in others. Issues on the agenda: More access to health care, new limits on school vouchers.

stories.title: A new generation of disability rights activists carry on Judy Heumann's legacy
stories.summary: The film Being Heumann tells the lesser-known story of the mother of the disability rights movement. A new generation of activists share how they "carry the torch" today.

stories.title: Judge temporarily blocks Trump from moving ahead on Washington public golf course redevelopment
stories.summary: A federal judge on Saturday ordered a two-week delay to any work at a historic Washington public golf course not far from the White House.

stories.title: FAA ground stop disrupts college football
stories.summary: Some college football games were delayed a few hours on Saturday or postponed to Sunday. And in Oklahoma at least, there will be perks for fans to make up for the inconvenience, including cheap beers.

stories.title: Florida city cancels St. Patrick's Day parade, citing new anti-DEI law
stories.summary: A new Florida law that prohibits taxpayer dollars from going toward diversity initiatives has prompted Delray Beach to cancel its St. Patrick's Day parade after a nearly 60-year run.

stories.title: Maintenance gone awry caused nation-wide ground stop, says Transportation Secretary
stories.summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy points blame toward contractor in explaining Friday's nation-wide aviation ground stop.

stories.title: US has lost measles elimination status, global health authorities say
stories.summary: The U.S. has lost its status as a country where measles is eliminated, according to researchers with direct knowledge of the deliberations at the Pan American Health Organization.

stories.title: SpaceX successfully catches Starship and makes history
stories.summary: The company's spacecraft returned to its Texas launchpad in dramatic fashion — by carefully lowering itself until two metal arms attached to the launch tower could secure it.

stories.title: Bomb found near ethanol plant in central Illinois forces evacuations
stories.summary: The bomb was discovered Friday afternoon at the BioUrja Renewables plant in Peoria. Officials say the bomb has been "rendered safe," but called it a "credible threat." The FBI is investigating.

stories.title: Tax the rich — sometimes. California voters sent mixed signals with ballot measures
stories.summary: California voters shot down a tax on billionaires' assets but said yes to a high-income tax. They were just two of the five tax questions on the ballot.

stories.title: CA Insurance Department accidentally reveals another judge complained about internal misconduct
stories.summary: Department responds to fired judge’s lawsuit, calling allegations ‘egregious.’ In doing so, it disclosed that a current judge also filed complaints with the State Bar.

stories.title: ¿Qué ocurre cuando los agentes inmobiliarios tienen conflictos de intereses?
stories.summary: Una demanda presentada en el condado de Sonoma alega que una de las agencias inmobiliarias más grandes del norte de California obligó a los compradores a firmar contratos de "doble representación".

stories.title: ¿Cuál es el futuro de la pena de muerte en California tras los indultos de Newsom?
stories.summary: Las conmutaciones de penas de muerte llevadas a cabo por el gobernador Gavin Newsom evidencian el profundo cambio que ha experimentado California en materia de justicia penal a lo largo de tres décadas. Sin embargo, la pena de muerte sigue formando parte de un statu quo contradictorio.

stories.title: Votantes de California reforman las elecciones revocatorias y aprueban la Proposición 5, respaldada por los demócratas
stories.summary: Tras una reñida contienda, los californianos respaldaron a los líderes demócratas y aprobaron su propuesta de modificación del proceso de revocación de mandato. Este proceso se llevará a cabo en dos fases: primero, se decidirá si el funcionario debe ser destituido; y segundo, quién lo reemplazará.

stories.title: Newsom’s power move bruised Dems. Now, they look forward to the Becerra era
stories.summary: It’s Xavier Becerra’s honeymoon period, and he’s pledging to treat Democratic leaders in the Capitol better than the last guy. We’ll see how the promise holds come budget season. stories.title: California needs to better resist job-killing megamergers in entertainment
stories.summary: Mergers like the recent ones between Paramount and Warner Bros and between Fox Corp. and Roku are endanger jobs and hurt consumers.

stories.title: By emptying death row, Newsom broke a promise and disregarded the will of voters
stories.summary: Despite promising to respect voters' support for capital punishment, Gavin Newsom moved to empty death row in the waning days of his governorship.

stories.title: Newsom spared 500+ death row inmates. Some DAs still plan to seek the death penalty
stories.summary: Gov. Gavin Newsom’s commutations of death sentences marked how far California has changed on criminal justice over three decades. Yet the death penalty remains part of a contradictory status quo.

stories.title: What happens when real estate agents have split allegiances?
stories.summary: A Sonoma County lawsuit alleges that one of northern California’s largest real estate brokerages shunted buyers into “dual agency” contracts.

ticker.title: Our guide to every Week 10 game: Matchup previews, predictions, picks and nuggets
ticker.summary: Kirk Cousins' return to Minnesota? Patriots vs. Lions in Germany? There are 13 more games in Week 10, and we have picks, predictions and more for all of them.

ticker.title: 15 predictions: What we expect from Chuba Hubbard, Aaron Rodgers, George Kittle
ticker.summary: Touchdown for Chuba Hubbard? Fantasy upside for Aaron Rodgers? Trick play from the Raiders? Let's predict 15 things for Week 10.

ticker.title: Inactives watch: Walker, Montgomery out; Pickens expected to play
ticker.summary: Updated inactives and analysis based on the latest reports and official announcements leading up to kickoff.

ticker.title: Last-minute pickups for Week 10: Estime, Tyson among worthy adds
ticker.summary: If injuries, bye weeks or tough matchups have you seeking lineup help, Matt Bowen lists potential options.
